items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: Because in Teddy Powell’s band, we had Charlie Ventura on the band

ctx.x: Grove Dictionary, right okay. Anyway so the Charlie Barnet thing was like I was sitting at home, I had just left Teddy Powell’s band or Lee Castle’s band. Teddy Powell’s band I think. That’s another story, that Teddy Powell was weird. Because in Teddy Powell’s band, we had Charlie Ventura on the band, it was magnificent. And Teddy loved him and he used to have arrangements written for Charlie that Charlie would play. He would feature him, and he’d play the introduction [scats] and when he got a call from Gene…

about you, I says, “see if he wants to come with the band.” And I said, “oh I’d love to but my brother Teddy’s in New York, I don’t think he’s working and I’ve got a job.” So he says, “you would do that for your brother?” I said, “hey he’s my brother man. I’ve got a job with Teddy Powell, so call my brother.” And he called my brother and he was available and he took the job, he went with Gene. So now Teddy takes the job with Gene and I’m with Powell’s band, oh then when Charlie gave his notice, we’re doing a date…
